## Summary

Describe the change and the operational problem it solves.

## Related issue or plan

Link the issue or approved engineering plan.

## Verification

- [ ] Added or updated automated tests where applicable
- [ ] Ran local checks; included commands and results
- [ ] Considered data fidelity, security, and privacy implications
- [ ] Updated relevant documentation
- [ ] Used only synthetic/authorized example and test data

## Risks and limitations

Document anything unsupported, unverified, or still requiring product review.
